-- The fact at the staging grain, one row per source line. Only DAMIR columns with a
-- dictionary entry: a draft for any other column couldn't be graded (ADR 0012). So
-- ETB_DCS_MCO stays out, and so does staging's surrogate key, tested there.
-- Every column is cast to its contract type, as in every mart: dbt compares the type
-- names each adapter reports, so a type that changes upstream (an expression, a
-- Snowflake VARCHAR length) would fail the contract on one warehouse and not the other.
select
    cast(FLX_ANN_MOI as integer) as FLX_ANN_MOI,
    cast(ORG_CLE_REG as integer) as ORG_CLE_REG,
    cast(AGE_BEN_SNDS as integer) as AGE_BEN_SNDS,
    cast(BEN_RES_REG as integer) as BEN_RES_REG,
    cast(BEN_CMU_TOP as integer) as BEN_CMU_TOP,
    cast(BEN_QLT_COD as integer) as BEN_QLT_COD,
    cast(BEN_SEX_COD as integer) as BEN_SEX_COD,
    cast(DDP_SPE_COD as integer) as DDP_SPE_COD,
    cast(ETE_CAT_SNDS as integer) as ETE_CAT_SNDS,
    cast(ETE_REG_COD as integer) as ETE_REG_COD,
    cast(ETE_TYP_SNDS as integer) as ETE_TYP_SNDS,
    cast(ETP_REG_COD as integer) as ETP_REG_COD,
    cast(ETP_CAT_SNDS as integer) as ETP_CAT_SNDS,
    cast(MDT_TYP_COD as integer) as MDT_TYP_COD,
    cast(MFT_COD as integer) as MFT_COD,
    cast(PRS_FJH_TYP as integer) as PRS_FJH_TYP,
    cast(PRS_ACT_COG as decimal(18, 2)) as PRS_ACT_COG,
    cast(PRS_ACT_NBR as integer) as PRS_ACT_NBR,
    cast(PRS_ACT_QTE as integer) as PRS_ACT_QTE,
    cast(PRS_DEP_MNT as decimal(18, 2)) as PRS_DEP_MNT,
    cast(PRS_PAI_MNT as decimal(18, 2)) as PRS_PAI_MNT,
    cast(PRS_REM_BSE as decimal(18, 2)) as PRS_REM_BSE,
    cast(PRS_REM_MNT as decimal(18, 2)) as PRS_REM_MNT,
    cast(FLT_ACT_COG as decimal(18, 2)) as FLT_ACT_COG,
    cast(FLT_ACT_NBR as integer) as FLT_ACT_NBR,
    cast(FLT_ACT_QTE as integer) as FLT_ACT_QTE,
    cast(FLT_PAI_MNT as decimal(18, 2)) as FLT_PAI_MNT,
    cast(FLT_DEP_MNT as decimal(18, 2)) as FLT_DEP_MNT,
    cast(FLT_REM_MNT as decimal(18, 2)) as FLT_REM_MNT,
    cast(SOI_ANN as varchar) as SOI_ANN,
    cast(SOI_MOI as varchar) as SOI_MOI,
    cast(ASU_NAT as integer) as ASU_NAT,
    cast(ATT_NAT as integer) as ATT_NAT,
    cast(CPL_COD as integer) as CPL_COD,
    cast(CPT_ENV_TYP as integer) as CPT_ENV_TYP,
    cast(DRG_AFF_NAT as integer) as DRG_AFF_NAT,
    cast(ETE_IND_TAA as integer) as ETE_IND_TAA,
    cast(EXO_MTF as integer) as EXO_MTF,
    cast(MTM_NAT as integer) as MTM_NAT,
    cast(PRS_NAT as integer) as PRS_NAT,
    cast(PRS_PPU_SEC as integer) as PRS_PPU_SEC,

    cast(PSP_SPE_SNDS as integer) as PSP_SPE_SNDS,
    cast(PSP_STJ_SNDS as integer) as PSP_STJ_SNDS,
    cast(TOP_PS5_TRG as integer) as TOP_PS5_TRG
from "ANALYTICS"."STAGING".stg_damir__prestations

-- One row per source line. No two lines of the three pinned months share a grain key
-- (loader/profile_sources.py, 2026-09-29), so there is nothing to aggregate, and the
-- key's `unique` test fails on a future file that repeats one. RAW already declares
-- every type (loader/raw_prestations.sql): staging trims the text codes and adds the key.

-- The grain: every field but the measures, 1 to 16 and 30 to 56, the fields
-- `grain_key` in loader/offline_sample.py cuts the sample by;
-- tests/warehouse/test_staging.py checks the two lists match.

with source as (

    select
        FLX_ANN_MOI,
        ORG_CLE_REG,
        AGE_BEN_SNDS,
        BEN_RES_REG,
        BEN_CMU_TOP,
        BEN_QLT_COD,
        BEN_SEX_COD,
        DDP_SPE_COD,
        ETE_CAT_SNDS,
        ETE_REG_COD,
        ETE_TYP_SNDS,
        ETP_REG_COD,
        ETP_CAT_SNDS,
        MDT_TYP_COD,
        MFT_COD,
        PRS_FJH_TYP,
        PRS_ACT_COG,
        PRS_ACT_NBR,
        PRS_ACT_QTE,
        PRS_DEP_MNT,
        PRS_PAI_MNT,
        PRS_REM_BSE,
        PRS_REM_MNT,
        FLT_ACT_COG,
        FLT_ACT_NBR,
        FLT_ACT_QTE,
        FLT_PAI_MNT,
        FLT_DEP_MNT,
        FLT_REM_MNT,
        trim(SOI_ANN) as SOI_ANN,
        trim(SOI_MOI) as SOI_MOI,
        ASU_NAT,
        ATT_NAT,
        CPL_COD,
        CPT_ENV_TYP,
        DRG_AFF_NAT,
        ETE_IND_TAA,
        EXO_MTF,
        MTM_NAT,
        PRS_NAT,
        PRS_PPU_SEC,
        PRS_REM_TAU,
        PRS_REM_TYP,
        PRS_PDS_QCP,
        EXE_INS_REG,
        PSE_ACT_SNDS,
        PSE_ACT_CAT,
        PSE_SPE_SNDS,
        PSE_STJ_SNDS,
        PRE_INS_REG,
        PSP_ACT_SNDS,
        PSP_ACT_CAT,
        PSP_SPE_SNDS,
        PSP_STJ_SNDS,
        TOP_PS5_TRG,
        trim(ETB_DCS_MCO) as ETB_DCS_MCO
    from "RAW"."DAMIR"."PRESTATIONS"

)

select
    -- `concat_ws` skips a NULL on DuckDB but returns NULL on Snowflake, which would null
    -- the whole key there, so each field is coalesced. No grain field is nullable in RAW.
    md5(concat_ws('|',
        coalesce(cast(FLX_ANN_MOI as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ORG_CLE_REG as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(AGE_BEN_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(BEN_RES_REG as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(BEN_CMU_TOP as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(BEN_QLT_COD as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(BEN_SEX_COD as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(DDP_SPE_COD as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ETE_CAT_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ETE_REG_COD as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ETE_TYP_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ETP_REG_COD as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ETP_CAT_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(MDT_TYP_COD as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(MFT_COD as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PRS_FJH_TYP as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(SOI_ANN as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(SOI_MOI as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ASU_NAT as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ATT_NAT as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(CPL_COD as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(CPT_ENV_TYP as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(DRG_AFF_NAT as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ETE_IND_TAA as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(EXO_MTF as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(MTM_NAT as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PRS_NAT as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PRS_PPU_SEC as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PRS_REM_TAU as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PRS_REM_TYP as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PRS_PDS_QCP as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(EXE_INS_REG as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PSE_ACT_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PSE_ACT_CAT as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PSE_SPE_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PSE_STJ_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PRE_INS_REG as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PSP_ACT_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PSP_ACT_CAT as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PSP_SPE_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(PSP_STJ_SNDS as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(TOP_PS5_TRG as varchar), ''),
        coalesce(cast(ETB_DCS_MCO as varchar), '')
    )) as PRESTATION_KEY,
    *
from source
